svg.title: RE-Harbor VOID — Media Home
svg.desc: Clean original vector product mockup of RE-Harbor's cinematic home. Individually drawn navigation icons, editorial Odyssey hero, six distinct continue-watching covers, nine streaming services, nine miniature poster designs, and a full-width music dock. This is a mockup, not a software screenshot.

g.text: After the Trojan War, Odysseus begins a dangerous journey
across the sea — through myth, monsters, and the unknown.
